name: shopeasy-store-starter
description: Configurable multi-market storefront with product, inventory, checkout and management; English, Sorani, Arabic, Dutch and French UI.

scripts.audit: npm run build:cloudflare && npm run preflight:release && npm run check && npm test && npm run audit:static && node scripts/template-audit.mjs
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run preflight:cloudflare-auth && npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler@4.147.0 dev
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run preflight:cloudflare-auth && npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler@4.147.0 deploy
scripts.dry-run:cloudflare: npm run preflight:cloudflare-auth && npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler@4.147.0 deploy --dry-run
scripts.audit:free-first: npm run build:cloudflare && npm run preflight:release && npm run check && npm run audit:static && node scripts/template-audit.mjs && npm test
scripts.dev:cloudflare:staging: npm run preflight:cloudflare-auth && npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler@4.147.0 dev --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.dry-run:cloudflare:staging: npm run preflight:cloudflare-auth && npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler@4.147.0 deploy --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:staging: npm run preflight:cloudflare-auth && npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler@4.147.0 deploy --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/check-test-dependencies.mjs && node scripts/run-tests.mjs test/manager-dashboard.integration.test.js test/product-variants.integration.test.js test/template-syntax.test.js test/upload-quota.integration.test.js
